correctness.rationale: The exact iterated Volterra kernel holds for nonunivalent polynomial symbols by integration and induction; \(H^2\) boundary Minkowski plus coefficient positivity gives all-\(k\) explicit rank-one error. Triangle-equality maximizers are \(h\) equally spaced points, each with Hessian \(-2\sigma^2\) variance coefficient. Gaussian Laplace gives norm of \(g^k\) with sharp constant and O(\(k^{-1}\)) relative error; dividing the O(\(k^{-1}\)) absolute \(G^k/k!\) estimate by the \(k^{-1/4}\) leading norm gives O(\(k^{-3/4}\)) relative error. Compactness and approximation-number minimax imply the \(s_2/s_1\) bound. Replayed independent coefficient expansions and 168 supplementary finite assertions are consistent, not infinite proofs.

value.rationale: Exact sharp norm asymptotics determine a natural quantitative quasi-nilpotency invariant for a broad genuinely nonmonomial class. The same proof identifies effective one-channel singular geometry and the arithmetic count of boundary saddle points; it gives a universal leading coefficient across two-monomial symbols independent of degree gap. This goes beyond a finite computation or cosmetic reformulation, without asserting a paper-scale general theorem or an optimal remainder.
